question: Which native Settlers production filters are shared by the human unit menu, AI candidate generation and ordinary completion, and what remains before a human/AI construction prohibition?

scope.boundary: Four exact generated functions and bounded native-only AI caller and CityUpdate windows were inspected. The native-only CityUpdate windows use its accepted generated mapping despite the eight-byte canonical Ghidra function listing. No AI evaluator, command producer/writer, creation helper, save/restore thunk or post-list indirect target body was opened. The result identifies conditional local admission and completion gates, not complete return, execution, a universal construction ban or a patch.

Accepted post-setup recount and separate serializer/load-owner locators.

Neither path contains a demonstrated OCC disable switch. Do not equate Settlers0 and FSettler1, name UEA45 or owner word0x830ED3D8 from this test, treat population/cost tuning as disabling production, or infer global human/AI parity from three callers.

conclusion: Retained Settlers0 passes its sentinel technology filters and is locally admitted when population>=3, or>=2 under UEA45 or the owner-word5 condition. Identified human mode1 and AI mode-1 callers share this candidate loop; FSettler1 fails its first zero-input prerequisite. Ordinary unit completion independently checks production cost and the equivalent population threshold before calling unit creation. These are concrete human/AI construction-related gates, not proof that a list-only change enforces OCC or that the whole creation/queue path returns and retains state.

populationRequirementAssessment.supportedIdea: An unattainable comparison threshold is a possible future construction policy at the shared candidate and independent completion checks. The observed thresholds are encoded in code for definition flag+0x50 bit1, not an identified per-unit minimum-population table field. All admitted flag1 definitions share that logic, so changing the common constants is not established as Settlers0-only.
